identity.title: [v0.92.1][DRT-05] Qualify identity authority TLS capabilities and provider failure

values.task_boundary: Implement only DRT-05 within its exact owned paths and authority boundary.
deliverables: Producer-derived security and failure matrix with exact envelope and authority inputs.
Independent verifier for every positive and negative outcome without hard-coded counts.
acceptance_criteria: Voting, agent, Shepherd, operator, and Observatory identities use separated keys and roles; Shepherd cannot vote.
Production TLS chains to an approved trust anchor and no self-signed certificate appears on a production path.
Forged, stale, wrong-domain, missing-capability, cross-polis, malformed, and pre-auth disclosure attempts are denied with typed receipts.
Provider timeout, stall, malformed output, and partial failure preserve state and authority invariants.
non_goals: Generating outcome totals independently of producer results
